claim: Salesforce posted its highest-ever gross profit—$5.8B—in Q4 of fiscal 2023.
summary: From knowledge alone without tools or citations, the exact Q4 FY2023 gross profit amount and whether it was a record high cannot be established, so the claim cannot be verified.

sub_claims.text: Salesforce reported gross profit of $5.8B in Q4 of fiscal 2023.
sub_claims.note: From existing knowledge alone without external sources the exact GAAP gross profit for the quarter ended Jan 31, 2023 cannot be recalled with certainty, so $5.8B cannot be confirmed.

sub_claims.text: That Q4 fiscal 2023 gross profit was Salesforce's highest-ever gross profit.
sub_claims.note: From existing knowledge alone without external sources whether Q4 fiscal 2023 exceeded all prior quarterly gross profit amounts cannot be established.
